findings.mechanism: Correlation identifiers are not propagated; logs contain only static message without request context, preventing single-request log retrieval.
findings.remediation: Add a correlation_id to each event, propagate it through record_delivery, and include it in logger calls (e.g., logger.info('recorded %s id=%s', result, correlation_id)). Use contextvars to carry the ID across async calls.

findings.mechanism: Latency is measured only after the work is done; queueing time before inbox.take() is not captured, so end‑to‑end latency appears lower than user‑perceived latency.
findings.remediation: Instrument start time before awaiting inbox.take() and record end‑to‑end duration, exposing http_req_duration_p99 metric.

findings.mechanism: Errors from record_delivery are not caught or attributed to specific request IDs, making error rates unlinked to root causes.
findings.remediation: Wrap record_delivery call in try/except, log error with event identifiers, and increment an error metric labeled with correlation_id.
